name: Rachel Fleischman, LCSW
reason: Mainly therapy and condition-framed: her own site (rachelfleischman.com) presents her as a psychotherapist (founder of Bliss Counseling, a San Francisco private practice) whose workshops and keynotes are built around stress, burnout, nervous-system regulation and 'nighttime anxiety' for sleep; her Dance Your Bliss movement classes are framed the same way and her book is not yet published, so too little spiritual teaching would pass the health and therapy rules. (Email dancingyourbliss@gmail.com is published on /contact if the owner wants her anyway.)
